purpose: A text in English (user 2026-11-11: the words of an OFF, so that SigLIP 2 finds the pictures and the captions of the shots), as a plug-in program. Version 2 (docs/102 step 5): the request names the model; the program finds it in the AI catalog of the computer it runs on. Nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

translate.body: { model, texts: [text] }: model is a model's name (its file or folder name)
translate.ok: { texts: [text] }: each text in English, in the order given

rules: At most 16 texts a request, each at most 4000 bytes. The plug-in reads only the models of its own computer's AI catalog and writes nothing; a model it has not is an error.
acceptance: crates/qnc-text-translate/examples/translate_with_program.rs (texts of a file through the program, only read).
